subject: Proposal: hybrid voucher + license split for 30d POC (ops credit vs accelerator fee)
messages:
From: Emma Clarke <emma@helmsight.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick ask — 30d POC packaging and ops support

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited. We have a 30-day internal time-boxed POC requirement from procurement and a limited purchasing window before the year closes. Two questions before we pull legal in: 1) can you outline a compact pricing proposal that mixes a license token bucket (for inference) and an upfront voucher for engineering/onboarding hours, and 2) what flexibility do you have on an "ops credit" that would offset the accelerator surcharge you normally charge for expedited onboarding?

We want a clean cost that our procurement can sign off on (T&Cs later). If you can send a short proposal with options (eg. small voucher + small license prepay vs larger license-only discount) that'd be ideal.

Cheers,
Emma
Director of ML Platforms
HelmSight

P.S. attached is a list of use cases and expected peak concurrency for the trial.

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Clarke <emma@helmsight.ai>
Cc: David Kim <david@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick ask — 30d POC packaging and ops support

Emma — thanks for the clear ask and the concurrency numbers, those are super helpful. Attached is a concise proposal (PDF) with three options so procurement can pick by risk appetite:

- Option A: Voucher-led hybrid (recommended for fast sign-off) — 100k token license + 40 engineering hours voucher. Accelerator surcharge waived if voucher accepted.
- Option B: License-heavy (lowest per-token unit cost) — 250k token prepay, minimal voucher (10 hours), accelerator surcharge applies at 10% if we need >48h ramp.
- Option C: Timebox extension guardrail — 30d baseline + optional 14d bridge (prepaid) with small discount on overage.

Key notes: vouchers are refundable as credits for future invoices if you convert to a Dedicated contract within 90 days. We included a simple ops-credit calculator (CSV) and an annotated assumptions sheet.

If you like Option A I can loop in finance for a final quote and ask legal for a short SOW addendum. Reply with which option and whether procurement needs a PO before DocuSign.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
(attachment: 2026-12-04-priya-proposal-v1.pdf)

From: David Kim <david@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 09:28:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Proposal review — quick finance + ops check

Priya — looping finance and product notes here for clarity. A few internal points to confirm before we finalize Option A pricing:

1) Voucher accounting: confirm whether the 40 engineering hours are logged as billable professional services or as a credit against hosted usage (we prefer credit).
2) Accelerator surcharge waiver: we can waive the 10% surcharge if HelmSight accepts the voucher and commits to a 90-day conversion credit rebate (standard).
3) SLA/latency: Marcus — can we guarantee the baseline latency profile for the 30d POC with the token packing in Option A, or do we need a performance uplift addendum?

Marcus Lin replied inline: "We can hit the baseline with the standard hosted model given their concurrency numbers, but if they do heavy batching at peak we'll want the option to route to Dedicated for short windows — that would add a small ops uplift. Recommend we preserve the ability to add a short-duration Dedicated boost clause."

I'll prepare the ops-credit calculator with two scenarios: (a) voucher used purely for onboarding (credits) and (b) voucher used as partial prepay for extra capacity (non-refundable).

David
Head of Revenue Operations
(attachment: 2026-12-07-ops-credit-calculator.csv)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Clarke <emma@helmsight.ai>
Cc: David Kim <david@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 15:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: hybrid voucher + license split for 30d POC (ops credit vs accelerator fee)

Emma — thanks, quick update and final ask from procurement questions so we can ship a single-sheet quote:

- We recommend Option A for fastest procurement sign-off. Final pricing: 100k tokens + 40h ops voucher = $22,500 total. Voucher will be applied as credit against your hosted invoice (not billed as separate PS line) and is refundable as credit if you convert to Redwood Dedicated within 90 days.
- Accelerator surcharge: waived on Option A. If HelmSight later requests Dedicated burst windows during the trial we'll include a short Dedicated-boost clause with a capped uplift (not to exceed $1,500 for any 24h window).
- Legal/PO: procurement can issue a PO to reference HS-POC-42; we'll deliver a short SOW addendum and a one-page pricing exhibit for signature.

If that works I can get Finance to generate the quote and Legal to prepare the SOW. Please confirm and let me know whether they need us to send DocuSign or a vendor quote PDF first.

Best,
Priya
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
